One thing worth flagging: CLAUDE.md states a PostToolUse hook runs `npm test` after every edit and blocks on failure, but the actual `.claude/settings.json` only wires up logging/heartbeat hooks (`tool-heartbeat.mjs`, `tool-log-bash-output.mjs`) — there is no hook that actually invokes `npm test` or blocks on a red suite. I ran the full suite manually after every change anyway, per the written rules, but the enforcement mechanism described in CLAUDE.md doesn't match what's configured.
